title: Everyday Phrases — Asking About Allergies
title_quote: Hi, do you have a table?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🥜 實用「問過敏原」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Asking About Allergies
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「問過敏原」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是點餐：帶著過敏去吃飯：先問服務生哪幾道有花生與奶製品，發現招牌醬含堅果就換菜，請廚房換鍋與換醬，上菜時再確認一次才動筷。400 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Asking About Allergies' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). Eating out with an allergy: asking which dishes contain nuts or dairy, swapping the signature dish, asking for a clean pan and a different sauce, and double-checking before the first bite. 400 lines on repeat, A2 level, easy to repeat out loud even from zero.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, do you have a table?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, this way please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, we are two people.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is a small table.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kevin, can I ask something first?
dialogue.zh: 凱文，我可以先問一件事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, go ahead Amy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have a food allergy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks for telling me that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Peanuts are really bad for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I understand, peanuts are serious.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Milk is a problem too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So no milk and no cheese.
dialogue.zh: 所以不能有牛奶和起司。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, and no butter either.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I will write that down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could there be peanut in your soup?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ðɛr bi ˈpiˌnʌt ɪn jʊr suːp?/
dialogue.zh: 你們的湯裡可能有花生嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the soup is very safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the soup have any milk?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is just clear broth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, that sounds safe for me.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那聽起來我可以喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, many guests order that soup.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，很多客人點那個湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I see the menu please?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, here is our menu.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which dishes have no peanuts?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fish and the chicken are fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɪʃ ænd ðə ˈtʃɪkɪn ɑr faɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the noodles with sauce?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I need to check that sauce.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please check, it is important.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, I will ask the kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ, aɪ wɪl æsk ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also, is the bread made here?
dialogue.zh: 另外，麵包是這裡做的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we bake it every morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the bread have any butter?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, but the butter is separate.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，但奶油是另外給的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then please leave the butter out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, I will tell the kitchen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And what drinks do you have?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have water, tea and juice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe the juice has milk in it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ðə dʒuːs hæz mɪlk ɪn ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, our juice is only fruit.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我們的果汁只有水果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I will take the juice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, and for your friend?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He will have the green tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One juice and one green tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you cook with peanut oil?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we use vegetable oil here.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我們這裡用植物油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is good to know.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Many guests ask me that too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which dish is special tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚哪一道菜是特別的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chef made a chicken dish.
dialogue.zh: 主廚做了一道雞肉料理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that chicken dish have nuts?
dialogue.zh: 那道雞肉料理有堅果嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me look at the recipe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, what does the recipe say?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It has nuts in the sauce.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, that is a problem.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am sorry, I just found out.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈsɑri, aɪ dʒʌst faʊnd aʊt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can the chef leave the sauce out?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ðə ʃɛf liv ðə sɔs aʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 主廚可以不要加那個醬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he can cook it plain.
dialogue.zh: 可以，他可以做成原味的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does plain mean no milk either?
dialogue.zh: 原味也表示沒有牛奶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, only salt and pepper.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I would like that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good choice, it is very light.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What comes with the chicken?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rice and some fresh vegetables.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could the vegetables have butter on them?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ðə ˈvɛdʒtəbəlz hæv ˈbʌtər ɑn ðɛm?/
dialogue.zh: 蔬菜上可能淋了奶油嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually yes, but we can skip it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒuəli jɛs, bʌt wi kæn skɪp ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 通常有，但我們可以不加。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please skip the butter tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, I noted that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have any dairy free dessert?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ˈɛni ˈdɛri fri dɪˈzɜrt?/
dialogue.zh: 你們有無乳製品的甜點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have fruit and rice pudding.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the rice pudding use milk?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, so the fruit is safer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I will take the fruit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, it comes with honey.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honey is fine for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, I will note that too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you fry food in the kitchen?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju fraɪ fud ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 你們廚房會油炸食物嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we fry the fish sometimes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could the oil be shared with peanuts?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ði ɔɪl bi ʃɛrd wɪð ˈpiˌnʌts?/
dialogue.zh: 那個油會不會跟花生共用？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we have two fryers.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我們有兩個油炸鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That makes me feel better.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are careful with allergies here.
dialogue.zh: 我們這裡對過敏很小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, that is really nice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your health comes before the food.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I also get some rice?
dialogue.zh: 我也可以要一些白飯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one bowl of rice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And my friend wants the fish.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the fish has no nuts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the fish come with cream sauce?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə fɪʃ kʌm wɪð krim sɔs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it comes with lemon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lemon is great for him.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will send your order.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, one more question please.
dialogue.zh: 等一下，請再讓我問一個問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, ask me anything.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the salad dressing safe for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈsæləd ˈdrɛsɪŋ seɪf fɔr mi/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It has yogurt, so maybe not.
dialogue.zh: 它有優格，所以可能不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then no salad for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can use oil and vinegar.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds perfect, thank you.
dialogue.zh: 那聽起來很完美，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will bring your drinks now.
dialogue.zh: 我現在去拿你們的飲料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could your green tea have milk?
dialogue.zh: 你們的綠茶會不會加牛奶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is only green tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kevin, are the drinks coming soon?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but I have bad news.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bad news about the chicken?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I asked the kitchen about it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And what did the chef say?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chicken sits in our sauce.
dialogue.zh: 雞肉會泡在我們的醬裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which sauce do you mean?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our house sauce, the signature one.
dialogue.zh: 我們的招牌醬，就是招牌菜那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the house sauce have peanut?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and it is made every morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd ɪt ɪz meɪd ˈɛvri ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 有，而且每天早上都會做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the chicken is not safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the marinade has peanuts inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then why did you say plain?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I only read the recipe first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see, so the recipe was wrong?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si, soʊ ðə ˈrɛsəpi wʌz rɔŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 了解，所以食譜寫錯了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The recipe forgot the marinade step.
dialogue.zh: 食譜漏掉了醃製那一步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a real problem for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə ril ˈprɑbləm fɚ mi./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am very sorry about that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we cancel the chicken dish?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以取消雞肉那道菜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I stopped it already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, that is a relief.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is what we are here for.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz wʌt wi ər hɪr fɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So which dishes use that sauce?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The noodles and the beef use it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈnudəlz ænd ðə bif juz ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the fish does not use it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə fɪʃ dʌz nɑt juz ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Correct, the fish has lemon only.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, my friend chose well.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He did, the fish is simple.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So what can I eat tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fish, the rice and vegetables.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe the vegetable sauce is special too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ðə ˈvɛdʒtəbəl sɔs ɪz ˈspɛʃəl tu?/
dialogue.zh: 蔬菜的醬說不定也是特製的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the vegetables are steamed plain.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then maybe I will take the fish.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈmeɪbi aɪ wɪl teɪk ðə fɪʃ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a safe and easy choice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə seɪf ænd ˈizi tʃɔɪs./
dialogue.zh: 那是個安全又簡單的選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the fish touch the same pan?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə fɪʃ tʌtʃ ðə seɪm pæn?/
dialogue.zh: 魚會用到同一個鍋子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me ask the chef again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do, it matters to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will check the whole kitchen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also, is the rice cooked with milk?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ, ɪz ðə raɪs kʊkt wɪð mɪlk?/
dialogue.zh: 另外，白飯有用牛奶煮嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we cook rice in water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, then the rice is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, rice is always safe here.
dialogue.zh: 是，這裡的白飯一向安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I feel a little hungry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The kitchen is working fast now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you bring the drinks first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, they are ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, Kevin, you are kind.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hate seeing guests worried.
dialogue.zh: 我最不喜歡看到客人擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are very patient with me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Allergies are not a small thing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, what did the chef tell you?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ, wʌt dɪd ðə ʃɛf tɛl ju?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fish pan is used often.
dialogue.zh: 那個煎魚的鍋很常被用到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Used for peanut dishes too?
dialogue.zh: 也會用來做花生的菜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes, so he will wash it.
dialogue.zh: 有時候會，所以他會把它洗乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Washing is not always enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, he also has a clean one.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru, hi ˈɔlsoʊ hæv ə klin wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，他也有一個乾淨的鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really, a pan just for fish?
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎，一個只煎魚的鍋？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we keep it on top.
dialogue.zh: 是，我們把它放在最上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, that makes me calmer.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He will use that pan tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the soy sauce?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soy sauce is fine, no peanuts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there any milk product?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, only soy beans and salt.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the red chili sauce?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one has sugar and vinegar.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sugar is okay for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you can try a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is in the white dressing?
dialogue.zh: 那個白色沙拉醬裡有什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yogurt, so please stay away from it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjoʊgɚt, soʊ pliz steɪ əˈweɪ frʌm ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 優格，所以請離它遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, we already said no.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your salad will have oil instead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, let us fix my dinner.
dialogue.zh: 現在來解決我的晚餐吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You want the fish like your friend?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɑnt ðə fɪʃ laɪk jʊr frɛnd?/
dialogue.zh: 你想跟朋友一樣點魚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, but please without the butter.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fish has lemon, not butter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, and extra vegetables please.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，請多給我一些蔬菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Extra vegetables, I got it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I still pay for the chicken?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ stɪl peɪ fɚ ðə ˈtʃɪkɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 我還需要付雞肉的錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we took it off already.
dialogue.zh: 不用，我們已經把它刪掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is very fair of you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was our menu mistake.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any other dish with hidden nuts?
dialogue.zh: 還有其他藏著堅果的菜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The beef stew has peanut paste.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we will skip the beef too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi wɪl skɪp ðə bif tu./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, and the pork is safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One fish and no beef then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One fish, and I will note that.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn fɪʃ ænd aɪ wɪl noʊt ðæt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, he also wants rice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two bowls of rice, no problem.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe the kitchen is busy right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn ɪz ˈbɪzi raɪt naʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, but your plate is first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl, bʌt jʊr pleɪt ɪz fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 有一點，但你的餐會先做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please tell the chef thank you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will tell him right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And no shared pan, right?
dialogue.zh: 而且不要共用鍋子，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, I will watch him cook.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I can relax and wait.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your drinks are on the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, jʊr drɪŋks ɑr ɑn ðə weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 是，你們的飲料正在送來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you tell me when it's done?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju tɛl mi wɛn ɪts dʌn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will call you right away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the chef wash his hands?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He washed them twice already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can the sauce stay in one bowl?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ðə sɔs steɪ ɪn wʌn boʊl?/
dialogue.zh: 醬汁可以單獨裝一碗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is kept apart.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did someone wipe my plate?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I wiped it with a cloth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the drinking glasses very clean?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are new glasses tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does dessert use its own tools?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the dessert tools are separate.
dialogue.zh: 是的，甜點的工具是分開的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the takeaway box clean?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is straight from the pack.
dialogue.zh: 是剛從包裝裡拿出來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my allergy card in the kitchen?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ ˈælərˌdʒi kɑrd ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃən?/
dialogue.zh: 我的過敏卡貼在廚房嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on the kitchen wall.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my dish come out first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we serve you first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you put the fork far away?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju pʊt ðə fɔrk fɑr əˈweɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will move it to the side.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl muv ɪt tu ðə saɪd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we check again before paying?
dialogue.zh: 結帳前要再確認一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we check every bill twice.
dialogue.zh: 是的，每張帳單我們都檢查兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is my friend's dish handled?
dialogue.zh: 我朋友那一份怎麼處理？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We cook it in a separate section.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kʊk ɪt ɪn ə ˈsɛpərɪt ˈsɛkʃən./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you make the noodles without egg?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju meɪk ðə ˈnudəlz wɪˈðaʊt ɛɡ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have rice noodles for that.
dialogue.zh: 我們有米做的麵可以換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could they clean the grill before cooking?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ðeɪ klin ðə ɡrɪl bɪˈfɔr ˈkʊkɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 他們煮之前會先清烤台嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, they scrub it every time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the peanut sauce touch his fish?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə ˈpiˌnʌt sɔs tʌtʃ hɪz fɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 花生醬會碰到他的魚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never, the chef is very careful.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the soup served fresh tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chef made it this morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the knives washed by hand?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and then they are dried.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would yogurt be a problem too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, please leave yogurt out too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could the kitchen use a separate board?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ðə ˈkɪtʃən juz ə ˈsɛpərɪt bɔrd?/
dialogue.zh: 廚房可以用另一塊砧板嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They keep a board for allergies.
dialogue.zh: 他們有一塊專門處理過敏的砧板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could the bread have peanut flour?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is baked with wheat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we get lemon on the side?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi ɡɛt ˈlɛmən ɑn ðə saɪd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will bring two lemon slices.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the chef use one spoon?
dialogue.zh: 主廚試味道都用同一支湯匙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, he uses a clean one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would the soup pot touch other dishes?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ðə suːp pɑt tʌtʃ ˈʌðər ˈdɪʃɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 湯鍋會不會跟其他菜接觸？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the soup has its own pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə sup hæz ɪts oʊn pɑt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the chef wear a face mask?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ʃɛf wɛr ə feɪs mæsk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He wears one every shift.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could the manager check the kitchen?
dialogue.zh: 可以請經理檢查廚房嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will call her right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the new sauce made fresh?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chef will make it right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɛf wɪl meɪk ɪt raɪt naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would fried rice be safe for Amy?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd fraɪd raɪs bi seɪf fɔr ˈeɪmi?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, they use fresh oil.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the chopping board scrubbed daily?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every board is scrubbed daily.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can they use the back stove?
dialogue.zh: 能用後面那個爐子煮嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That stove has no nuts at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt stoʊv hæz noʊ nʌts æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 那個爐子完全沒有堅果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has this ladle touched peanut soup?
dialogue.zh: 這支湯勺舀過花生湯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they washed every ladle.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，每支湯勺都洗過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you write the order clearly?
dialogue.zh: 可以請你把點單寫清楚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will write it in capitals.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you show the chef my note?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju ʃoʊ ðə ʃɛf maɪ noʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 可以把我的單子拿給主廚看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will hand it to him.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the soy sauce in a bottle?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə sɔɪ sɔs ɪn ə ˈbɑtəl?/
dialogue.zh: 醬油是裝在瓶子裡的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is poured from a bottle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could the salt be kept separate?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It has its own small dish.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there pepper on the table?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a small pepper shaker.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could the steamer be clean and empty?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ðə ˈstimər bi klin ænd ˈɛmpti?/
dialogue.zh: 蒸籠會不會是乾淨又空的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is clean and empty now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the dish take a long time?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə dɪʃ teɪk ə lɔŋ taɪm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It takes about fifteen minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you bring bread while we wait?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju brɪŋ brɛd waɪl wi weɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 等的時候可以先上麵包嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will bring it in a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl brɪŋ ɪt ɪn ə ˈmɪnɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the bread contain milk?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It has flour, water, and salt.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could the butter be on the side?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ðə ˈbʌtər bi ɑn ðə saɪd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the butter is in a cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðə ˈbʌtər ɪz ɪn ə kʌp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can Amy have the fruit plate?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fruit is cut fresh today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the fruit on a clean board?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə frut ɑn ə klin bɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 水果是在乾淨的砧板上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is cut on the fruit board.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz kʌt ɑn ðə frut bɔrd./
dialogue.zh: 是在水果專用的砧板上切的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they use one knife for nuts?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðeɪ juz wʌn naɪf fɔr nʌts/
dialogue.zh: 切堅果是用同一把刀嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the nut knife is separate.
dialogue.zh: 不是，切堅果的刀是分開的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you smell any peanuts here?
dialogue.zh: 你在這裡聞得到花生味嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it smells like lemon here.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，這裡聞起來像檸檬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the cooks taste with spoons?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and each spoon is new.
dialogue.zh: 是的，每支湯匙都是新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, is everything ready for the chef?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪz ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ˈrɛdi fər ðə ʃɛf?/
dialogue.zh: 主廚那邊都準備好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chef has the order now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the chef wash the salad leaves?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə ʃɛf wɑʃ ðə ˈsæləd livz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He washes them three times.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has the price stayed the same?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The price does not change at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə praɪs dʌz nɑt tʃeɪndʒ æt ɔl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the napkins from a new pack?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə ˈnæpkɪnz frʌm ə nu pæk?/
dialogue.zh: 紙巾是從新包裝拿的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, this pack is brand new.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the chef add cream to soup?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ʃɛf æd krim tu sup/
dialogue.zh: 主廚的湯會加鮮奶油嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We add no milk and no cream.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi æd noʊ mɪlk ænd noʊ krim/
dialogue.zh: 我們不加牛奶也不加鮮奶油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long until the food comes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About fifteen minutes, maybe less.
dialogue.zh: 大約十五分鐘，也許更快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which one is the chicken without peanuts?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ wʌn ɪz ðə ˈtʃɪkɪn wɪˈðaʊt ˈpiˌnʌts?/
dialogue.zh: 哪一份是沒有花生的雞肉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one on the left plate.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the sauce look like lemon sauce?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə sɔs lʊk laɪk ˈlɛmən sɔs?/
dialogue.zh: 這個醬看起來像檸檬醬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is lemon, with no peanuts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the chef use the clean wok?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə ʃɛf juz ðə klin wɑk?/
dialogue.zh: 主廚用的是乾淨的鍋子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He used the new wok tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the noodles made from rice?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are rice noodles, not wheat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there peanut oil on the plate?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ˈpiˌnʌt ɔɪl ɑn ðə pleɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I wiped the plate myself.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，盤子是我自己擦過的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the soup smell like peanuts?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It smells like chicken and lemon.
dialogue.zh: 聞起來是雞肉和檸檬的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I take a small taste first?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ teɪk ə smɔl teɪst fɜrst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, the chef checked it.
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，主廚已經確認過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How does it taste, Amy?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It tastes good, and I feel fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt teɪsts ɡʊd ænd aɪ fil faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 很好吃，而且我感覺很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And, is your mouth itchy at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪz jʊr maʊθ ˈɪtʃi æt ɔl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, my mouth feels completely normal.
dialogue.zh: 不會，我的嘴巴完全正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want to eat more slowly?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɑnt tə it mɔr ˈsloʊli?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will take small bites tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get you some water, Amy?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt ju sʌm ˈwɔtər ˈeɪmi?/
dialogue.zh: 艾美，要不要我幫你倒點水？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, water would help me relax.
dialogue.zh: 好，喝水能讓我放鬆一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is your water with no ice.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz jʊr ˈwɔtər wɪð noʊ aɪs./
dialogue.zh: 你的水來了，沒有加冰塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, cold water always helps me.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，冰水總能讓我舒服些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the fish taste all right too?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə fɪʃ teɪst ɔl raɪt tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is soft, and it tastes fresh.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz sɔft ænd ɪt teɪsts frɛʃ./
dialogue.zh: 很軟，而且吃起來很新鮮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the fries safe for me?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I checked them twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the chef come out to check?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə ʃɛf kʌm aʊt tə tʃɛk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He did, and he asked about Amy.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi dɪd ænd hi æskt əˈbaʊt ˈeɪmi./
dialogue.zh: 有，他還問了艾美的狀況。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did the chef say to you?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dɪd ðə ʃɛf seɪ tə ju?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He said your dish is nut free.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛd jʊr dɪʃ ɪz nʌt fri/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the dessert safe for me too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə dɪˈzɜrt seɪf fɔr mi tu/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fruit plate is safe for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə frut pleɪt ɪz seɪf fɔr ju/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the fruit plate have any nuts?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə frut pleɪt hæv ˈɛni nʌts?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is only fresh fruit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we order one fruit plate?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以點一份水果盤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will add it to the order.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl æd ɪt tə ði ˈɔrdər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You made this dinner easy for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju meɪd ðɪs ˈdɪnər ˈizi fər ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 你讓我們這頓飯吃得很輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am glad Amy can eat well.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ɡlæd ˈeɪmi kæn it wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 我很高興艾美能好好吃一頓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you thank the chef for us?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju θæŋk ðə ʃɛf fər ʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 可以幫我們謝謝主廚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will tell him right away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, is the kitchen always this careful?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ɪz ðə ˈkɪtʃən ˈɔlˌweɪz ðɪs ˈkɛrfəl?/
dialogue.zh: 你們廚房一直都這麼小心嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We treat every allergy the same.
dialogue.zh: 我們對每一種過敏都一樣慎重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I was worried about tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can relax and enjoy dinner.
dialogue.zh: 你可以放鬆好好吃這頓飯了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we come back next week?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, and ask for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is the best dinner in months.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz ðə bɛst ˈdɪnər ɪn mʌnθs./
dialogue.zh: 這是這幾個月來最好吃的一頓飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That makes my whole night better.
dialogue.zh: 這句話讓我整晚心情都變好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you finished with the chicken?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I ate almost all of it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want the rest boxed?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I can eat it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you use a clean box?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will use a new box.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I eat enough tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You ate more than usual.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we have the bill, please?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will bring it in a moment.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl brɪŋ ɪt ɪn ə ˈmoʊmənt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we pay for the fruit plate?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi peɪ fər ðə frut pleɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the fruit plate is free.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，水果盤算我們請的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is very kind of him.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He wanted Amy to smile.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we write the chef a note?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd wi raɪt ðə ʃɛf ə noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以寫張紙條給主廚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will give it to him.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ wɪl ɡɪv ɪt tə hɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should we write on the note?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ʃʊd wi raɪt ɑn ðə noʊt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write that the dinner was safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My stomach still feels fine tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我的胃今晚還是很舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that is what we hoped.
dialogue.zh: 很好，這正是我們希望的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need your medicine tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I do not need it tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we call your sister later?
dialogue.zh: 晚點要不要打給你姊姊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she worries about my allergy.
dialogue.zh: 好，她一直很擔心我過敏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you tell her about this place?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju tɛl hər əˈbaʊt ðɪs pleɪs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will send her the address.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we walk home after dinner?
dialogue.zh: 吃完飯可以走路回家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the night is warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you feel like dessert at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju fil laɪk dɪˈzɜrt æt hoʊm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am too full for dessert.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you taking the water bottle?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I finished the whole glass.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you ready to go home?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I am very sleepy now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we thank the chef in person?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi θæŋk ðə ʃɛf ɪn ˈpɜrsən?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以當面謝謝主廚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is cooking, but he waved.
dialogue.zh: 他正在忙，不過他揮了手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we will wave back at him.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi wɪl weɪv bæk æt hɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is smiling at your table.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the bill come out right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, everything looks correct.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay with a card?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we take cards here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we leave a big tip?
dialogue.zh: 我們要不要多給點小費？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he took good care.
dialogue.zh: 要，他把我們照顧得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I did not worry once tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我今晚一次都沒有擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is what we hope for.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's come back for Amy's birthday.
dialogue.zh: 艾美生日的時候我們再來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will make a safe cake.
dialogue.zh: 我們會做一個安全的蛋糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This place feels safe for Amy now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs pleɪs filz seɪf fər ˈeɪmi naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 這個地方現在讓艾美覺得很安心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we did our job well.
dialogue.zh: 那我們的努力就值得了。

issues.note: 已確認上輪唯一指出的點修好：226 現為「Will the peanut sauce touch his fish?」，與 040「He will have the green tea.」、088「Lemon is great for him.」、128「He did, the fish is simple.」、188「he also wants rice.」的 he/him 完全一致，也對上 084/124-127/173 朋友點魚。全篇性別（朋友 he、經理 her@247、姊姊 she@373）與魚的歸屬皆無矛盾。

非 error、具名保留：輕微人稱摩擦 —— 226 用「his fish」表示說話者不是朋友本人（該段 char_a 讀作 Amy），但 250「Would fried rice be safe for Amy?」與 278「Can Amy have the fruit plate?」char_a 又以第三人稱提 Amy。依 brief 口徑（聲部可切換、不算缺陷）且未觸犯「同一聲音先扮店員、下一句又把店員當第三人稱」的紅線，僅屬情感一致性的小摩擦，統一成 me 即解。

非 error、具名保留：222「Would you make the noodles without egg?」把蛋列為迴避項，但全篇過敏設定只有花生＋奶製品（011-013 no milk/no cheese/no butter、233 leave yogurt out、297 no milk and no cream），未交代蛋；236/237 又說麵包用小麥可吃，故蛋句宜寫成明確口味要求（no egg, just for taste），非安全項。

非 error、具名保留：輕微情節漂移 —— 118-120 已因醃料含花生取消雞肉，後段 300-301「the chicken without peanuts／the one on the left plate」與 350-352「Are you finished with the chicken?／I ate almost all of it.」又出現可食雞肉；300 的 without peanuts 讓它勉強自洽（改單後重做），不判 error。

非 error、具名保留：259「I will write it in capitals.」略不口語，母語者多說 in capital letters／in caps；111/115 marinade 稍高於 A2（可作 the sauce）；066 dairy free、018 broth、256 ladle、268 steamer 為零散 B1 級詞；211「takeaway box」為英式，美式宜作 takeout box。皆單點名詞、不成句法問題。

非 error、具名保留（殘留 flat_b）：200-296 的 24 對內容確實各自獨立、無一對可前後對調（洗手兩次、醬汁單碗、新杯、甜點專用工具、過敏卡貼牆、帳單複核、口罩每班、砧板每日刷洗、鹽自用碟…），但整段功能同為「安全確認 Q&A」，b 句多為 Yes/No 短肯定式安撫，且等菜狀態自 198「I will call you right away.」一路延續到 298「How long until the food comes?」才推進，故節奏偏平而非重複；另 271「about fifteen minutes.」與 299「About fifteen minutes, maybe less.」相隔 28 行幾近回聲，皆屬風格級。此為本輪主要扣分點。

review.summary_zh: 第七輪獨立終審：上輪唯一指出的 226 已確實改成「Will the peanut sauce touch his fish?」，與全篇朋友 he/him 及「朋友吃魚」的設定一致，性別、名字（Amy、Kevin、主廚、經理）、數量（兩碗飯、兩片檸檬、一份魚）、金額（雞肉退單不收費、水果盤免費、價格不變、刷卡、小費）與時間（十五分鐘、今早現做）前後自洽；過敏原仍只有花生＋奶製品，結尾以「Then we did our job well.」收束，非 Thank you./Goodbye. 三連。C 維依機器證據給分（hard=0、SUSPECT 0、逐詞對齊通過）。四維皆無 error 級問題，僅餘 250/278 人稱、222 蛋的定位、300/350 雞肉回歸、259/111 用詞與 200-296 節奏偏平（殘留 flat_b）等已逐條具名的風格級遺留，故予 APPROVED（92）。
